verdicts.reason: Both crop the photo so tightly that the face is cut off above the nose and the eyes are lost, which makes the hero image hard to read and weakens fidelity to the original. In A, the lightbulb, atom and question-mark doodles sit right on the cheek and mouth, cluttering the face; that is clearly unintended. B moves the atom and question mark into the empty grey area next to the headline, where they read as decoration. Only B's lightbulb still clips the chin. B's headline block also sits better between its doodles, but the right-side molecule nearly touches 'WORKS?'.
